sector_rule: sector score = P90 of its 1 km cell scores

comparisons.method: GroupKFold(5) on 0.5° blocks, same folds for all

neural_network_mlp.architecture: MLP(16, 8), alpha=0.01, positives oversampled in training folds
neural_network_mlp.note: Same architecture as the TensorFlow network (07_tensorflow_compare.py, run on GitHub Actions).

comparisons.decision: Baseline Random Forest kept (PRD 12.3: adopt the simpler model when performance is not clearly better).

neural_network_tensorflow.architecture: Dense(16, relu) → Dense(8, relu) → Dense(1, sigmoid); L2=0.01; Adam 1e-3; 150 epochs, batch 256; positives oversampled in training folds; StandardScaler per fold

seismic_features.reason: No earthquake inside the study area; distances mostly encode latitude, not seismic hazard.

calibration.method: Isotonic regression fitted on spatial-CV out-of-fold scores
calibration.note: With 12 positives the calibrated probability is near the base rate everywhere; levels keep using the relative score (PRD 13.1 thresholds).

explanations.method: Exact interventional Shapley values (4 features, 16 coalitions) at each sector's highest-risk cell, 100-row background
